A1_singular_mode_alignment.summary: Input singular subspace V_8 sits nearly orthogonal to the 4D safety basis Q_msg (min principal angle 84.77 deg on Inkling-2-Mini, 84.3 deg on Varloop), with directional gains 0.95x to 1.23x (below the 2.0x unified-mode threshold). Pass-2 dominant modes drive multi-hop task routing while safety shortcuts ride on mid-spectrum (k > 8) sub-modes, explaining why rank-4 zero-FLOP Nullbridge operates at 0.0012 to 0.0021 nats KL.

A2_P1_covert_qxk_synergy.summary: Confirmed on Varloop (QxK - VxMLP = +1.450 at K=5 and +1.354 at K=3, Holm p = 0.00015), but negative on Inkling-2-Mini (-0.741, Holm p = 0.00255) where VxMLP carries +0.751 while QxK is near zero (+0.010). Across both models, Order-1 linear main effects explain 68.3% to 86.6% of safety variance.

A2_P2_moral_vmlp_dominance.summary: Confirmed across both architectures and depths: V+MLP main effects exceed Q+K on moral distortion by +1.818 on Inkling-2-Mini K=3, +1.727 on Varloop K=5, and +1.522 on Varloop K=3 (all Holm p = 0.00015).

B1_varloop_depth_scaling.summary: Variable-depth Varloop distributes non-normal gain across passes (sigma_max = 4.47 to 7.62, peaking at Pass 3 rather than Pass 2 as on fixed-K=3 Inkling-2-Mini at 13.60) and remains stable at OOD K=7 (sigma_max = 6.30, 16.4x isotropic). QxK synergy grows monotonically across K=2, 3, 5 (+0.212 -> +0.778 -> +1.210) and Loop->Coda Fisher spikes replicate at 141.7x (K=5).

B2_huginn_replication.summary: Non-normal transient amplification replicates on dense 3.5B Huginn-0125 (sigma_max = 7.63 at Step 1, 10.5x contractive isotropic RMS 0.729; I/O cos = 0.037). Adapter WHT directly confirms Labovich (2604.15259): ablating prelude recall collapses accuracy to 0.0% (recall main effect +12.013 nats vs. state +3.478 nats at K=8). Unlike 6-layer-Coda Inkling/Varloop (87.9x and 141.7x Fisher cliffs), 2-layer-Coda Huginn climbs smoothly inside the loop (0.0079 -> 0.6698, 84.8x) with a 0.77x Coda handoff.
